ads_ratio.reason: Teck is a direct-listed foreign private issuer: one NYSE-traded TECK share is one Class B subordinate voting share, so no ADS conversion applies; per-share figures and the traded price are on the same basis.
ads_ratio.source: Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-19), cover page: securities registered under Section 12(b) are 'Class B subordinate voting shares', trading symbol TECK, listed directly on the New York Stock Exchange — the NYSE security is the Class B share itself, not an ADS

moat_against: Pure commodity price-taker: no pricing power; earnings are set by copper/zinc prices it does not control
Structurally capex-heavy: latest-FY owner's earnings were negative after capex despite positive operating cash flow
Cyclical and volatile OE: OE/share range over the last 5 years spans >3x (engine OE_VOLATILE flag)
Quebrada Blanca ramp/tailings execution risk and a 2024 asset impairment show operating risk at the flagship growth asset
Pending Anglo American merger: China approval and integration risk; consideration is Anglo shares, not cash
Reserves deplete, decommissioning/restoration liabilities grow, and the dual-class structure concentrates voting control
moat_for: Tier-1, long-life copper/zinc reserves (Quebrada Blanca, Highland Valley, Red Dog, Antamina stake) that are scarce and hard to permit or replicate
Diversified copper + zinc + Trail smelting footprint across Canada, Chile, Peru and the US
Net-cash balance sheet after the steelmaking-coal sale (engine: net debt -9.6x normalized OE) funds the capex cycle without forced dilution
Highland Valley life extension sanctioned to 2046 and Quebrada Blanca ramp give visible volume growth
moat_justification: Scarce, long-life tier-1 copper and zinc assets in mining-friendly jurisdictions (Quebrada Blanca, Highland Valley, Red Dog, Antamina stake, Trail) that cannot be replicated quickly and were hard to permit — but Teck is a pure commodity price-taker with no pricing power, structurally heavy capex and stripping, depleting reserves, and owner's earnings that were negative in the latest fiscal year after capex; returns are set by the copper/zinc cycle, not by the franchise.
name: Teck Resources Limited
one_liner: Diversified copper/zinc miner, moat 4/10, net cash — but normalized owner's earnings are only $0.17/share against a $64.00 price: weighted IRR 0.1%, weighted IV@15 $1.61, and even the super-bull case clears only 3.2%; on this OE method it clears 15% only below ~$1.61 — the price rests on reserve/NAV value and the Anglo merger exchange terms, not on current owner's earnings.
